issue.title: Day strip Ctrl/Cmd/middle-click reuses an open Stats tab instead of opening a new one (openStatsForDay ignores newLeaf)

task_type_fields.impact: Bryan cannot open a second Stats tab from a Day strip with the usual Ctrl/Cmd-click or middle-click once Stats is open anywhere. Instead the existing tab is re-pinned and focused, which loses the view he wanted to keep beside the new one. This is minor UX inconsistency, not data loss.
task_type_fields.location: bob-plugins plugins/bob-ledger-tools/src/239-plugin-day-strip-fence.js openStatsForDay (reuse branch before openLinkText newLeaf)
task_type_fields.repro:
`openStatsForDay` in bob-plugins `plugins/bob-ledger-tools/src/239-plugin-day-strip-fence.js` first looks for an open `dash_stats` leaf (`findOpenMarkdownLeafByPath`). When it finds one, it reveals that leaf and returns `true`. `opts.newLeaf` is only consulted later, in the `workspace.openLinkText("dash_stats", sourcePath, opts.newLeaf === true)` fallback. So a Ctrl/Cmd-click or middle-click on a Day strip fact, the mix bar, or `Stats ↗` (which `239-plugin-day-strip-render.js:24` turns into `newLeaf: true`) never opens a new tab while Stats is already open in any tab.

Reproduce: open `dash_stats` in one tab, open a canonical daily note in another tab, and Ctrl/Cmd-click a Day strip fact. The existing Stats tab is revealed instead of a new tab opening. The plan `plan:202610/daily_note_day_strip.md` ("These links follow normal link semantics ... Ctrl/Cmd-click or middle-click opens a new tab") and every other ledger-tools link (`180-plugin-plan-and-ready.js`, `200-plugin-dashboard.js`, `210-plugin-ready-notes.js`) pass `newLeaf` straight to `openLinkText`. The existing test `scripts/test-ledger-tools-day-strip-hosts.cjs` "openStatsForDay pins the day, focuses the metric, and opens a new tab" only covers the no-open-leaf case.

Likely fix: skip the reveal-and-reuse branch when `opts.newLeaf === true`, so the pinned view state still applies and `openLinkText(..., true)` opens a new tab. Add a host test with an already-open `dash_stats` leaf plus `newLeaf: true`. Reword docs/stats.md "Interaction" ("An already-open Stats tab is reused; otherwise Ctrl/Cmd-click and middle-click open a new tab"), which bob-cli commit fd0fc2e5 wrote to describe the current behavior, so a plain click reuses the tab and a modified click always opens a new one. Then run `npm run build`, `npm test`, `npm run validate`, and `bob plugins sync`.

Provenance: first reported, unfixed, in the body of bob-cli commit fd0fc2e5 ("docs: verify refreshed contracts and clarify capture workflows", agent chop.refresh_docs.bob-cli.2). The batch-10 lander (bob-cli-an.6.6.6.5.6.5.5.6.6.land) confirmed it in bob-plugins source at 3bac436.

payload.entry: Resolved by batch-12 phase bob-cli-an.6.6.6.5.6.5.5.6.6.6.6.4, bob-plugins commit 8866540 and bob-cli docs commit 3633a10a. openStatsForDay skips the reveal-and-reuse branch when opts.newLeaf === true, so Ctrl/Cmd-click and middle-click open a new Stats tab with the pinned day/metric; a plain click still reuses an open tab (existing 'the open leaf is revealed and reused' test). New host test 'openStatsForDay opens a new tab when Stats is already open'. docs/stats.md Interaction now reads 'A plain click reuses an open Stats tab; Ctrl/Cmd-click and middle-click always open a new tab.' Lander verified the deployed vault bob-ledger-tools 1.73.0 main.js is byte-identical to master and contains the fix.
